text: ロケットだん　あいてに　なめた　まねして　くれるぜ

structure.jp: ロケットだん　あいてに
なめた　まねして　くれるぜ
structure.en: you sure pull a cheeky stunt on us

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる usually says someone does a thing for me as a favor; here it is sarcastic, about something unwelcome done to the speaker. なめた　まねして　くれる = 'you go and pull a cheeky stunt on us'.

patterns.name: 〜をあいてに
patterns.span: ロケットだん　あいてに
patterns.explanation: A name followed by あいてに means 'with that one as your opponent'; the を is dropped in casual speech. ロケットだん　あいてに = 'against Team Rocket'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb sits right before a noun and tells you what kind it is. なめた　まね = 'behavior that makes light of us', a cheeky stunt.
